name: Palazzo Cordusio, a Gran Meliá Hotel
insider_take: This luxury palazzo sits in the heart of Milan's financial district, just steps from La Scala opera house and the iconic Duomo cathedral.
whats_special: Housed in a beautifully restored early 1900s building that once served as Milan's central post office, this Gran Meliá property blends neoclassical architecture with contemporary Italian design. The hotel's location on Cordusio Square places you at the intersection of Milan's most prestigious shopping streets and cultural landmarks.
pro_tip: Book a room facing Cordusio Square for stunning views of the historic Palazzo delle Assicurazioni Generali, and you're just a 3-minute walk to the Duomo through the elegant Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II.
dont_miss: The rooftop terrace offers breathtaking 360-degree views of Milan's skyline, including the Gothic spires of the Duomo. The hotel's restaurant features Milanese cuisine with ingredients sourced from local markets, and the building's original Art Nouveau details have been meticulously preserved throughout the property.
pros: Prime location steps from La Scala opera house and Duomo cathedral
Beautifully restored historic palazzo with elegant contemporary design
Sophisticated rooftop bar and restaurant with panoramic city views
Luxurious spa and wellness facilities with premium treatments
cons: Premium pricing reflecting luxury positioning and prime location
Historic building constraints may limit room size in some accommodations
